why_a_manifest: The epoch contract is integrator-owned authority and sits outside L-P0-EPOCH's declared roots (docs/program/console-capability-registry.json, docs/program/wave4-migration-slot-ledger.md, docs/evidence/console/wave4/**).
problem: The contract admitted only a serialized rebase/cherry-pick train. Rebase is classifier-blocked on this spine, so under the contract as written every wave-4 lane is formally inadmissible. Plain merge is also what every successful landing in this program has actually used: wave-1, wave-2/3, and the openapi integration.
old_text:
The complete closure is a serialized rebase/cherry-pick admission train:
`epoch → authorized leaf → direct receipt-only review → … → manifest-only
admission`. No merge, unreviewed intermediate, unrelated commit, or divergent
leaf branch is admitted.
new_text:
The complete closure is a serialized **plain-merge** admission train:
`epoch → authorized leaf → direct receipt-only review → … → manifest-only
admission`, where each lane integrates with `git merge origin/<spine>` before it
pushes. Amended 2026-07-25 by wave-4 decision D-2: the previous clause admitted
only a rebase/cherry-pick train, but rebase is classifier-blocked on this spine,
which made every fan-out lane formally inadmissible. **The rebase/cherry-pick
clause is struck, not carried forward and not escalated. No lane may rebase.**
The merge commit that integrates the spine is the admitted merge; unreviewed
intermediates, unrelated commits, and divergent leaf branches remain rejected.
Shared OpenAPI, generated clients, migrations, route/nav, tokens and generated
Buck faces remain integrator manifests, exactly as the paragraph below requires.
invariants_preserved: Serialized train, one lane at a time.
Receipt-only review commits stay direct and unreviewed intermediates stay rejected.
Shared roots (openapi, clients, migrations, route/nav, tokens, generated Buck faces) remain integrator manifests — contract lines 126-127 are untouched.
consequence: All 19 wave-4 lanes become admissible; no lane may rebase.
